name: m7-normativos
description: Create and review M7 corporate normative documents (POL/MAN/INS/ESP) following POL-M7-001 standards. The creating-politica skill emits an autocontido {slug}.html + {slug}.yaml pair — HTML ~1.4MB with CSS, TWK Everett fonts and logos inlined as base64 (works from file:// or HTTP); YAML sidecar canônico for the M7 Cockpit de Normativos. Template-based pipeline with 145 placeholders covering identity + content of 8 sections, mapped from BRIEFING.md (YAML) + politica-{slug}.md (structured markdown). v3.2 internaliza auto-cleanup de slots vazios (Princípios/Papéis/DOC_REL), expande DOC_REL para 10 slots dinâmicos com fallback row, trata governance.parent: null com fallback semântico, e revisa hierarquia tipográfica h3.sub/h4.subsub. 3-phase workflow: Discovery → Redação MD → Produção HTML+YAML. MAN/INS/ESP skills still emit DOCX (migration pending). Includes governance-writer agent and QA compliance review skill.
